newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Santista Alimentos maintained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santista Alimentos maintained.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it was maintaining its hold rating on Brazil's Santista Alimentos.
-- Santista Alimentos reported a net income of 46 million reais in 1996 resulting from its restructuring program which was completed in 1995, it said.
--- The company's earnings also show that its operations came under less pressure from higher grain prices than most other firms in the food sector, it added.
-- Fator also said Santista Alimentos is concentrating its efforts on the soybean and wheat line and is improving its production and distribution logistics to cut costs.
-- "We believe that these factors combined with more stable wheat prices will slightly increase the gross margin in 1997 to 25.1 percent," it said.
-- Santista Alimentos common shares were up 4.55 percent at 2.30 reais in afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
